summary: `file_service` owns the image-4 storage read and write paths: tag allocation and the handle map, the open, read, write and close posters and their ten caller entries, result-slot helpers, post, status translation, media readiness, mediamsg routing with deferral and replay, the open interceptor, the media task and the open, write, close, close-with-entry-update, seek and release workers. The bodies link through the bank root into the fixed image behind branch veneers at the 35 stock entries; the other 28 request workers, including read, flush, format and media loss, remain stock.

rows.shim: Branch veneers at the 35 retired image-4 entries in `file_service/src/stock_requests.rs` and `file_service/src/stock_workers.rs`
rows.kind: veneer or carrier at a stock address
rows.other_side: retained image-4 callers of the stock tag, map, poster, result-slot, post, translation, readiness, media-task, mediamsg and open-interceptor entries, and the six worker-table words 0x814744..0x814774
rows.removal: no retained branch, literal or table word enters a retired extent

evidence.requirement: The linker places each four-byte A32 branch at its stock entry address and fills the rest of every retired extent with 0xe7f000f0.

rows.shim: Owned bodies behind the entry veneers in `file_service/src/stock.rs`, `file_service/src/stock_requests.rs` and `file_service/src/stock_workers.rs`
rows.other_side: the veneers at the 35 stock entries and the stock argument and return conventions of their callers
rows.removal: every caller uses the typed owned file-service API

evidence.requirement: The linker places every body in OWNED_FIXED with no writable statics.

rows.shim: Retained kernel, media, copy, path and filesystem services in `file_service/imports.ld`
rows.other_side: semaphore wait 0x724b68 and signal 0x724c00, cache claim 0x71e960 and release 0x71e9ec, current task 0x723cb8, local record 0x7111c4, position 0x7111e0 and open 0x711200, device lookup 0x70ec84, strcpy 0x70e748, memcpy 0x722054, media report 0x726c74, send 0x72503c, request receive 0x71fe2c, sleep 0x7240c8, wake 0x724144, tick read 0x7257a8, path services 0x7160b8, 0x715f0c, 0x71543c, 0x712dac and 0x716184, filesystem open 0x701634, write 0x6ff000, seek 0x6ff138, close 0x6ffff4, named close 0x6ffdcc, entry close 0x6ffb10 and release 0x6ffc68, written-file registration 0x71565c, post-close 0x71141c, rescan 0x71985c and media refresh 0x71d66c
rows.removal: owned kernel, media, copy, path and filesystem services replace every retained service the file service calls

evidence.requirement: The linker binds each retained service to its stock entry address.

rows.other_side: handle map 0x910140, tag table 0x9101c0, sequence 0x910200, result owner 0x910134 and slot 0x910138, media context 0x910204 and its device, flagged-close and directory-record fields, mediamsg session 0x910218, open set 0x910290, deferred requests 0x9102e0, media busy 0x940ac0 and media ticks 0x96bfb8
rows.removal: no retained code reads or writes these words

evidence.requirement: The bodies read and write the stock handle, tag, result-slot, media-context and mediamsg words in place.

rows.shim: Computed calls to retained workers and caller callbacks in `file_service/src/stock_requests.rs` and `file_service/src/stock_workers.rs`
rows.other_side: the 28 retained request workers in `routing::WORKERS`, caller-supplied completion callbacks and the open interceptor word 0x7217f0
rows.removal: every request worker and completion callback is owned and called directly

evidence.requirement: The media task, mediamsg router and open interceptor call guest code words, and the owned workers call caller-supplied completion callbacks, that are not definite linked references.

rows.shim: Global untyped assembly entries and linker publication labels
rows.kind: veneer or carrier at a stock address
rows.other_side: retained entry, compiler ABI and image-layout consumers
rows.removal: no consumer requires these published ABI or layout labels and both sides have stock comparisons in the same image

evidence.requirement: The exact global STT_NOTYPE entry and layout labels remain published by this linked image. Untyped symbols are not exempt from family accounting.
